# Synthetic recovery-retry candidate (not installed)

The exact btcwallet dependency f2c79d772865 reproduces missing local sync-index height961638 when initial SetSyncedTo is repeated after birthday persistence and recovery progress. In chainntfns.go the retry closure retains its original nil birthdayBlock; syncWithChain initializes/persists it locally then recovery can fail. The candidate refreshes the verified persisted birthday only for a nil argument, preserving the existing sync tip. It does not remove the previous-block database guard or reset birthdays/keys/data.

Reproduce in a temporary checkout of btcsuite/btcwallet f2c79d772865: copy waddrmgr_retry_test.go to waddrmgr/kilowallet_retry_test.go and wallet_retry_test.go to wallet/kilowallet_retry_test.go; apply candidate.patch with patch -p1; use tested-go.mod/tested-go.sum; run go test ./waddrmgr ./wallet -run 'TestKilowallet|Test.*Birthday|Test.*Sync' -count=1 -v. Go1.27.4 linux/amd64 was downloaded with SHA2567226736c2339719cda28fbf3a54d71aa63bcefe376e98cef00034268dab24840. All DBs are temporary synthetic wallets, no chain RPC or transactions.

Two targeted tests passed; matching BLAKE2b dependency tests passed11 top-level tests plus6 subtests. Negative control returning nil for a persisted verified birthday fails. The tests verify the actual database invariant and candidate read helper; they do not yet exercise the full asynchronous recovery retry loop. Full-loop fault injection and native engine rebuild/qualification remain required. Missing glyphs remain independently unresolved. This patch is retained for review/testing only; the release app still uses the original engine.
